blocks.text: Yeh chapter bunyadi computational structures, lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs, dekhta hai jo programming mein buniyadi hain: un ki khasusiyat, amal aur kaarkard tareeqe se banana, masle ke liye durust structure chunna, aur asal duniya mein un ka istemal.

Rozmarra zindagi mein hum data munazzam karte hain: phone mein contacts, karne ke kaamon ki list, kitchen mein plates ka dher. Computers ko bhi data munazzam aur sambhalna hota hai, aur computational structures is mein madad karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Har rozmarra misal ko structure se milaiye: karne ke kaamon ki list, plates ka dher, bank ki qataar.
blocks.explanation: Kaamon ki list: list; plates ka dher: stack; bank ki qataar: queue.

items: Computational structures data munazzam karte hain: lists, stacks, queues, trees aur graphs.
